integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, epic cinematic, a slow push-in through a dim, dusty server room overgrown with thick cobwebs, a single ancient computer monitor glowing at the center of the frame showing a progress bar stuck at "99%", a skeleton in an office chair slumped in front of it with one bony finger still on the mouse, dust drifting through a shaft of cold light. A deep, gravelly movie-trailer narrator (S1) says off-screen: <d>[English] In a world where your render outlived you...</d>

overall_soundscape: A low electrical hum, the slow creak of the office chair, and a single cooling fan rattling and winding down.

non_diegetic_music: Ominous low brass and taiko drums build slowly.

## pi-H3 FL2VA This is an FL2VA (first-last-frame to video and audio) workflow. It generates a video with synchronized audio from a text prompt, optionally conditioned on a first frame, a last frame, or both. ## Model links **Base model** - Download [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) and save it to
`models/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors` **pi-H3 adapters** - Download [pi_h3_2step_dwd_adapter_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lakonik/pi-H3/resolve/main/pi_h3_2step_dwd_adapter_int8_convrot.safetensors) and save it to
`models/loras/pi_h3_2step_dwd_adapter_int8_convrot.safetensors` Alternative full-precision version: [pi_h3_2step_dwd_adapter/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lakonik/pi-H3/resolve/main/pi_h3_2step_dwd_adapter/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors), saved to `models/loras/pi_h3_2step_dwd_adapter.safetensors` - Download [pi_h3_4step_dwd_adapter_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lakonik/pi-H3/resolve/main/pi_h3_4step_dwd_adapter_int8_convrot.safetensors) and save it to
`models/loras/pi_h3_4step_dwd_adapter_int8_convrot.safetensors` Alternative full-precision version: [pi_h3_4step_dwd_adapter/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lakonik/pi-H3/resolve/main/pi_h3_4step_dwd_adapter/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors), saved to `models/loras/pi_h3_4step_dwd_adapter.safetensors` **Text encoder** - Download [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) and save it to
`models/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors` **VAE** - Download [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) and save it to
`models/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors` The video VAE only encodes the first and last frames, and decodes the video in the workflow without DWD. - Download [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) and save it to
`models/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors` **Model Storage Location** ``` 📂 ComfyUI/ ├── 📂 models/ │ ├── 📂 diffusion_models/ │ │ └── minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors │ ├── 📂 loras/ │ │ ├── pi_h3_2step_dwd_adapter_int8_convrot.safetensors │ │ └── pi_h3_4step_dwd_adapter_int8_convrot.safetensors │ ├── 📂 vae/ │ │ ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors │ │ └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors │ └── 📂 text_encoders/ │ └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors ``` ## Sampler steps `steps` on `pi-H3 Adapter (2 or 4 steps)` selects the adapter and its recommended `max_raw_t` (0.93 for 2 steps, 0.96 for 4 steps). `final_step_size_scale` is 0.6. `ModelSamplingMiniMaxH3` sets the video and audio shifts (12 and 3 by default). ## Sparse attention `MiniMax H3 Spark Attention (SM120)` (Spark-Attn, for RTX 50 series and RTX PRO Blackwell GPUs) speeds up sampling. It comes from [Spark-H3](https://github.com/zechengtang/Spark-H3): see the pi-H3 docs of ComfyUI-piFlow for installation. Use the workflow for your GPU, or bypass the node to use dense attention.
